audit_model.authenticated_ingress: one prepared then terminal immutable row per authenticated invocation
audit_model.claimed_target: closed exactly-one typed identifier without target foreign key
audit_model.resolved_target: exact composite foreign key to resolved Command Invocation
audit_model.unresolved_target: terminal denied ingress row without fabricated Command Header
audit_model.transaction: resolved ingress Header Invocation Event and mutation commit or roll back together
audit_model.replay: every exact replay drift late denial and applied call appends ingress history
audit_model.header: immutable request identity with exactly-once canonical result finalization
audit_model.resolved_invocation: append-only target-verified authorization and execution audit

query_intents.purpose: load immutable authenticated ingress history for one trusted idempotency domain and key
